formal.initialize: from scratch; never resume baseline weights

comparison_rule: Report both training seeds and both evaluation seeds separately, including all six conditions, mean XY/yaw errors and early terminations. Increased stop counts do not imply passing 29/32. Check regression in all previously passing conditions; do not select checkpoints or adjust thresholds. Two training seeds provide preliminary replication only.
scope: One GPU at a time; stop on pipeline/configuration failure. No extra training beyond two 1500-iteration seeds, no reward/DR changes, no watchdog, no automatic GitHub push.
conclusion: Keep original 2% baseline: stop stability still below 29/32; right-turn regression in both training seeds. No further training.
retained: Configuration, source snapshots, aggregate/per-episode JSON metrics and learning curves retained. Checkpoints, trajectories, training/evaluation logs and TensorBoard events removed at user request.
